header:
Awesome Music and Audio Tools

> Open-source DAWs, synths, audio editors, plugins, music AI, transcription and audio programming libraries. Every entry shows its license. **Rules of this list:** every repo exists, is public, is not archived, states a license and has had a commit in the last year. One plain sentence each. Star counts and claims are the authors' own, we did not test every tool. Checked 2026-10-18. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
footer:
## How to choose

- **Check sample and model licenses.** Free software does not mean free samples.
- **Keep project backups.**
- **Check plugin formats** (VST3, CLAP, AU) against your DAW.
- **Check the license.**

## Contributing

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). One entry per pull request, plain words, real sources only.
